title: R\`enyi-Regularized Flow-Based Variational Inference for Bayesian Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2610.37169v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Variational inference with normalizing flows provides a flexible posterior approximation for Bayesian model calibration, but struggles when the posterior has several modes separated by regions of low probability mass. We study this behavior in a two-parameter twin experiment and regularize the variational objective. Under Gaussian observation errors and a Gaussian prior, the corresponding minimization objective is the expected Tikhonov calibration objective minus the differential entropy of the approximating distribution. However, the expected Tikhonov term favors concentration near one of the modes, while entropy maximization does not guarantee multimodality. We introduce a regularization term based on R\'enyi divergence that encourages the approximate posterior to cover the prior support. translated_title: Rényi正则化的基于流的贝叶斯校准变分推断
translated_abstract: 基于归一化流的变分推断为贝叶斯模型校准提供了灵活的后验近似，但当后验分布存在多个被低概率质量区域分隔的模态时，该方法表现不佳。我们在一个双参数孪生实验中研究了这种行为，并对变分目标进行正则化。在高斯观测误差和高斯先验下，相应的最小化目标为期望Tikhonov校准目标减去近似分布的微分熵。然而，期望Tikhonov项倾向于使分布在其中一个模态附近集中，而熵最大化并不能保证多模态性。我们引入了一个基于Rényi散度的正则化项，以鼓励近似后验覆盖先验的支撑集。在连通双峰的情形中，流近似能够表示两个模态；在模态良好分离的情形中，流与高斯混合频繁（此处摘要文本截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Rényi散度正则化项的流式变分推断方法，解决了贝叶斯校准中标准变分推断无法捕捉被低概率区域分隔的多模态后验分布的问题，使近似后验能够覆盖先验支撑并表示多个后验模态。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Rényi divergence regularization term for flow-based variational inference in Bayesian calibration, which overcomes the standard objective's failure to capture multimodal posteriors separated by low-probability regions by encouraging the approximate posterior to cover the prior support.
